idea-plugin.name: Activity Lab
idea-plugin.description:
A local editor activity simulator for IntelliJ IDEA.

Choose from 141 file profiles and 32 curated modes, save your language combinations, and inspect local session reports in an isolated sandbox.

Includes timed sessions, manual stop, pause and resume, three edit patterns, and local session reports. All simulation files stay in an isolated sandbox. No external activity-tracking service is contacted.

Developed by Albatany. © Albatany 2026.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 6.1.2: Standalone compatibility update. Generated shell-script and Markdown scratch filename stems no longer contain the log substring. Native editor tabs, document edits, and saves are preserved. Separately installed editor extensions may independently observe normal editor events. Earlier 6.1.0 standalone changes remain: Removed online catalog lookup, project-name override, external tracker metadata, and tracker diagnostics. Offline language profiles, saved selections, sandbox sessions, foreground/background controls, and local reports remain.
